name: ai.exmxc/exmxc
title: exmxc
description: AI Power Index rankings, sPEG growth-valuation data and AI commerce research.

tools.name: ex.ai_commerce.signal.get
tools.description: Versioned AI commerce evidence: signed-in app selection method checks, separate provider-API tests, shopper experience gates, and attributed survey, referral, and search context. No inferred agent purchases or market-share score.

release.description: Exact immutable release identifier; omit for latest.

tools.name: ex.ai_power.rankings.get
tools.description: Current exmxc editorial rankings and forecasts for 50 companies in 2026, 2027, and 2030 using the fixed Four Forces methodology. Immutable monthly editions preserve prior judgments.

edition.description: Exact dated edition ID; omit for latest.

year.description: Sort highest power first for this year; defaults to 2026.

tools.name: ex.entities.get
tools.description: Institutional entity intelligence dataset including industry, entity_type, posture, capability, and ECC scoring.

tools.name: ex.speg.get
tools.description: Scarcity-adjusted PEG valuation dataset covering AI infrastructure companies.

tools.name: ex.speg.index.get
tools.description: Evidence-backed durable-scarcity profiles with independently gated draft inclusion recommendations, immutable release semantics, full source provenance, and valuation fields kept separately nullable.

query.description: Optional issuer name, stable ID, or common ticker alias.

tools.name: ex.datasets.index.get
tools.description: Retrieve index of all bundled datasets available through the exmxc MCP server.

tools.name: ex.ai_power_index.get
tools.description: Historical weighted exposure scaffold. Its 0–10 totals and ranks are not current evidence-backed measurements of company power.

tools.name: ex.four_forces.get
tools.description: Historical v1 exposure scaffold across compute, interface, alignment, and energy; retained for compatibility, not as AI Power v2 judgments.

tools.name: ex.ai_power.profiles.get
tools.description: Evidence-backed entity–mechanism–market–time profiles. The pilot publishes anchored judgments or explicit unknowns; it has no universal composite or league table.

query.description: Optional company name, alias, or ticker.

tools.name: ex.power_lens.v2.get
tools.description: Resolve a pilot company and return its scoped mechanism, Four Forces mapping, four anchored judgments or explicit unknowns, evidence status, confidence, and versioned release metadata. No universal composite or rank is generated.

query.description: Company name, common alias, or supported public-market ticker.

tools.name: ex.entity_in_a_box.get
tools.description: System-level ontology dataset defining AI-era entity structure across ontology, dataset, schema, MCP endpoint, and interpretation layers.

tools.name: ex.power_lens.get
tools.description: Historical v1 exposure view. Resolves a supported company name or ticker and returns the original weighted exposure scaffold and adjacent datasets. It is not a current evidence-backed measurement of company power.

query.description: Company name, common alias, or supported public-market ticker.

tools.name: ex.reality_gap.get
tools.description: Archived July 21, 2026 edition (10 companies), not updated. Current company assessments: the AI Power Index.

query.description: Optional company name, common alias, or ticker.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

tools.name: ex.strategic_consequence.get
tools.description: Experimental scenario engine pinned to the legacy v1 exposure scaffold. Its relative outputs are not AI Power v2 profiles, probabilities, or universal measures of advantage.

query.description: Optional company name, common alias, or ticker for a company-specific consequence view.

limit.description: Number of entities to return in each relative advantage and pressure list.

tools.name: ex.ai_power.analysis.top
tools.description: Retrieve historical weighted exposure rankings from the v1 scaffold. Alphabetical presentation within ties does not imply different merit.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

tools.name: ex.eei.audit.run
tools.description: Collect page delivery, declared provider-purpose access policy, machine-readable identity evidence, a deterministic five-dimension Entity Clarity v2.1 score when assessable, a separate static-content adequacy flag, and a clearly labeled legacy website diagnostic for one public HTTPS URL.
